requirementSections.heading: Additional Courses

rules.commentRaw: Select 12-14 credits from the following list. At least 6 credits must be at the 400-level. Other relevant courses may count toward the minor pending approval by the Director of Undergraduate Studies. A list of these courses can be found on the department website.
